title: Resident Accounting Bulletin — Pet Addendum Pet Rent Across a Household
content:
Pet rent under the Pet Addendum is set across the household, not animal by animal in isolation.

## The rule

1. The pet approved earliest on the lease, judged by approval date, pays the full monthly pet rent of its addendum type.
2. Every later pet of the lease receives an additional-pet discount credit against each of its pet rent lines. The credit equals that later pet's own addendum type's discount on each pet after the first, multiplied by that later pet's own monthly pet rent, rounded half up to the cent.
3. When the earliest pet's addendum ends, the next-earliest pet becomes the first pet from the following charge day.
4. Assistance animals pay no pet rent and never count as the first pet.

## The same rule, as a table

| Position of the pet on the lease | Pet rent line | Additional-pet discount credit against that line |
|---|---|---|
| First pet — approved earliest | Full monthly pet rent of its addendum type | None |
| Any later pet | Its own addendum type's monthly pet rent | Its own type's discount on each pet after the first, multiplied by its own monthly pet rent, rounded half up to the cent |
| Assistance animal | No pet rent | Not applicable; it is never the first pet |

Both the rate and the base of the credit belong to the later pet itself: neither the first pet's rate nor the first pet's rent enters the credit.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical household: Pet A approved on 10 March, monthly pet rent 50.00, discount on each pet after the first 20%. Pet B approved on 2 June, monthly pet rent 40.00, discount on each pet after the first 25%. Hypothetical charge day: the 1st of the month.

- Pet A is the first pet. Its pet rent line is 50.00 and it receives no credit. Its own 20% rate plays no part while it is the first pet.
- Pet B is a later pet. Its pet rent line is 40.00; its credit is 25% of 40.00, which is 10.00, so its pet rent less the credit is 30.00.
- Pet A's addendum ends on 14 September. From the following charge day, 1 October, Pet B is the first pet and receives no additional-pet discount credit.

## Rounding (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical later pet with a monthly pet rent of 37.50 and a discount of 25% has an unrounded credit of 9.375; rounded half up to the cent, the credit is 9.38. A hypothetical monthly pet rent of 36.10 at 25% gives 9.025, rounded half up to 9.03.

## Points of judgement

- **Which pet is first when a household has an assistance animal and one pet?** The pet. The assistance animal never counts as the first pet, so the pet pays the full monthly pet rent of its addendum type with no credit.
- **What decides which pet is first?** The approval date: the pet approved earliest on the lease is the first pet.
- **When does the next-earliest pet stop receiving the credit after the first pet's addendum ends?** From the following charge day, when it becomes the first pet.
